posts.zh:
Timesheet 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。从 dsh 会话日志做基于 turn 的时间跟踪：总计、按天/项目/供应商/来源汇总、工具调用次数、失败率与首 token 延迟。CLI + agent 可调用 timesheet 工具，输出 dsh-timesheet/v1 报告。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9856e11b29b7565e57d2.html
posts.en:
Timesheet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Turn-based time tracking from dsh session logs: totals, per-day/project/provider/source rollups, tool-call counts, failure rates, and time-to-first-token. CLI + agent-callable timesheet tool with dsh-timesheet/v1 reports.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9856e11b29b7565e57d2.html
